title: Android Wear 2.0 Complications with Medtronic
body: I have tried and read all about the implementation of the complications with the regular xDrip+. I cannot get them to work at all using xDrip+ in either follow mode or with the Medtronic Uploader as a source. The only thing that shows up on my watch is Null. I am using Huawei watch, LG G5 as an uploader and Galaxy S8 as a follow phone. I have tried my watch and xDrip+ with both phones. Any help or insight would be greatly appreciated.

Did not build it myself but tried using both Sept 29th and Sept 30th nightlies (Even though nothing probably changed between the two)
Are you using the 640G "Android Uploader" app as the data source?
I have used that and also as just a follower.

I think its possible that because of the way the 640G data comes in to the system via the `Nightscout Emulation` route that it doesn't get relayed properly to the watch in a way that is needed for complications to work. I will need to look in to this more.
Thank you for you efforts. If you need any testing done, or if there is anything else I can do to help, please let me know
